title: Identification and molecular mechanisms of novel antioxidant peptides from fermented broad bean paste: A combined in silico and in vitro study.
authors: Lin, Hongbin; Zhao, Jianhua; Xie, Yuqing; Tang, Jie; Wang, Qin; Zhao, Jie; Xu, Min; Liu, Ping
one_liner_zh: 该研究鉴定发酵蚕豆酱抗氧化肽并探讨其通过Keap1-Nrf2通路的机制，涉及肽-蛋白对接，但对象为肽-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study aimed to investigate the antioxidative and cytoprotective activity of antioxidant peptides from fermented broad bean paste (FBBP) and explore their potential molecular mechanisms using a combined in silico and in vitro approach. Seven novel antioxidant peptides (VSRRFIYYL, SPAIPLP, PVPPPGG, KKDGYWWAKFK, LAWY, LGFMQF, and LPGCP) identified by integrated approaches of peptidomics and in silico bioinformatic analysis were synthesized, exhibiting strong antioxidant potential against in vitro radicals. Molecular docking results suggested that these peptides could form stable hydrogen bonds and solvent-accessible surface with key amino acid residues of Keap1, thus potentially regulating the Keap1-Nrf2 pathway by occupying the Nrf2-binding site on Keap1. Additionally, they exhibited strong cellular antioxidant activity and could protect HepG2 cells from AAPH-induced oxidative injury by reducing reactive oxygen species and MDA accumulation. This study firstly unraveled the molecular mechanisms of antioxidant peptides from FBBP, and provided a new theoretical basis for the high-value utilization of FBBP.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究发酵蚕豆酱（FBBP）中抗氧化肽的抗氧化及细胞保护活性，并采用计算机模拟与体外实验相结合的方法探讨其潜在分子机制。通过肽组学与计算机模拟生物信息学分析整合方法鉴定出的七种新型抗氧化肽（VSRRFIYYL、SPAIPLP、PVPPPGG、KKDGYWWAKFK、LAWY、LGFMQF和LPGCP）被合成，表现出对体外自由基的强抗氧化潜力。分子对接结果表明，这些肽能与Keap1的关键氨基酸残基形成稳定的氢键和溶剂可及表面，从而可能通过占据Keap1上的Nrf2结合位点来调节Keap1-Nrf2通路。此外，它们表现出较强的细胞抗氧化活性，并能通过减少活性氧和MDA积累，保护HepG2细胞免受AAPH诱导的氧化损伤。本研究首次揭示了FBBP中抗氧化肽的分子机制，并为FBBP的高值化利用提供了新的理论基础。
